recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a work group wants additional guidance about Interval, Range, or other elapsed-time representations, that should be handled as a new decision because the current source satisfies FHIR-16978 without redundant prose.
issue_request: FHIR-16978 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core datatypes issue asking to separate the Period comment into clearer prose: Period is a range of time interpreted by context, and Period is not a Duration/elapsed-time value.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 14293, mirrored as git commit a34d05c9054edcf85259b16ebbd00718f3efa201, which replaced the confusing old one-paragraph Period comment in source/datatypes/period.xml with the current two-paragraph wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps default datatypes through the active datatypes page machinery, so source/datatypes/period.xml remains in current build scope. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant or conflicting discussion. A later Period search hit, FHIR-20652, concerns Timing.repeat.period/frequency duplicate wording and does not affect this Period datatype comment.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because source/datatypes/period.xml already says a Period specifies a range of time, explains context-dependent whole-range versus one-value interpretation, and separately states that Period is not used for a duration with a Duration link.
